properties.imageInputHelp: Choose this input when running a batch. Each selected picture runs through the pipeline independently.
properties.peopleHelp: Choose pictures from your People or profiles shared with you. These references stay the same for every product in a batch.
properties.peopleConnectHelp: Connect this node to Generate Image → References to reuse the selected people in your generated pictures. The selected model’s reference-picture limit still applies.
properties.staticImageHelp: Reuse pictures from your Library, shared files or People.
properties.requiresMask: This model requires a connected mask or a selected mask picture.
properties.transparentTitle: Supports transparent image output; enable it in model settings.
properties.transparentHelp: For a transparent image, choose Background → Transparent and use PNG or WebP.
properties.promptPlaceholder: Describe the picture, or connect a text step.
properties.promptHelp: A connected prompt is combined with these instructions. The input picture and references use the selected model’s limits.
properties.removalHelp: $0 provider charge. One inference runs at a time. Full BiRefNet takes longer and needs more memory.
properties.localHelp: Local image processing has $0 provider charge. Outputs are limited to 40 megapixels.
properties.expandHelp: AI expansion uses the selected image model and its final confirmed price.
properties.enhancerHelp: These steps improve text; connect their output to an image generator’s Prompt input.
properties.gatewayHelp: {model} through AI Gateway. Text steps have confirmed usage costs too; their prices appear after Gateway confirms them.
properties.concatHelp: Text is joined in the order the connections were added.
properties.outputHelp: Outputs stay private in your Library. Download links always serve their original full-size files.

results.queuedNotice: Your run is saved in the queue. Processing may take a little longer to start after being idle; you can close this page and check it later.
results.pausedNotice: Background work continues. Watch progress to resume updates here. You can close this panel or leave the page.
results.awaitingPriceNotice: Generated pictures appear and continue through the pipeline once Gateway confirms their exact prices.
results.tableLabel: Batch progress by input and step
results.rerunTitle: Repeat this input with the saved workflow and settings
results.rerunRepeats: Repeats this input with the saved workflow and settings.
results.rerunLocalFree: Local steps have no provider charge.
results.rerunReplaced: Previous pictures stay in Assets; displayed results are replaced.

rerunBlocked.notCompleted: Only completed jobs can be rerun. Use Retry failed steps for failed or interrupted work.
rerunBlocked.cancelling: Wait for the remaining cancelled work to finish before rerunning a job.
rerunBlocked.pricePending: Wait for this job’s exact prices to be confirmed before rerunning it.
rerunBlocked.attemptLimit: This job has reached its five-attempt limit. Start a new run for more variants.

results.footnote: Each input has its own steps and results. Runs continue after you close the browser. Cancelling stops new work; accepted provider work may finish and be charged. The saved run uses its original pipeline revision.
results.archiveLimit: This collection exceeds the 200-picture or 256 MB archive limit. Use the original downloads on individual cards.
results.retryWarning: Successful steps stay saved. Retrying a failed or interrupted AI step can create another provider charge, including when an earlier call completed without a saved response.
results.retryConfirm: I understand that retried AI work can incur another charge.
